parallel_contract.caller_status_note: MEETING-PROTOCOL-ENGINE-R2-20261116 was not yet merged on origin/dev (cbe907ff2) at delivery time; this task provides the C2 interface (services/consultation/meeting_outputs.py: dispatch_proposals(meeting: dict) -> list[dict], read_downstream_status(proposal_id) -> {status, downstream_id, updated_at}) and verifies all 8 proposal kinds against the real in-process owner routes (research, evolution, persona harness/lesson-rule/strategy-pool, memory trade-lessons, governance approvals, and BFF Agora candidate decisions).

1_single_idempotent_dispatch_under_spons.summary: Each of the 8 proposal kinds (research_demand, evolution_proposal via sponsor_decision_bridge, harness_patch, lesson_candidate, lesson_rule, pool_decision, governance_approval, agora_candidate_decision) dispatches once and idempotently via durable ledger + Idempotency-Key under the sponsor persona's own identity (or sponsor_persona_id=None only for agora_candidate_decision). Advisors and private servants are rejected before any downstream write.

2_downstream_gates_unchanged.summary: Every dispatched proposal enters at its owner entry point's first state (open, proposed, draft, pending_governance_decision, requires_approved_envelope) and no meeting output marks anything approved, endorsed, or applied even if payload fields attempt to pre-approve.

3_dispatch_failure_recorded_and_retried_.summary: Transient or validation dispatch failures record status='failed', downstream_id=None, and error on both the ledger and the meeting proposal record. Retrying dispatch_proposals re-sends only failed proposals without duplicating already-dispatched proposals. read_downstream_status(proposal_id) queries the authoritative owner GET endpoint and updates both the ledger and the meeting record in place.
